title: Praised Interior Design and Roominess
summary: Reviews in this topic mostly praise the G70 interior’s look and overall appeal, while many other fragments mention the interior without enough detail to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe the interior as amazing, fantastic, excellent, and a standout part of the vehicle owners especially love.

negative.summary: The single negative review criticizes the interior as worse than the reviewer’s previous vehicles.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention the interior too briefly to show whether the customer view is favorable or unfavorable.

limitations: The sampled examples are heavily dominated by short, repetitive praise and brief mentions, so concrete details about design, roominess, or specific interior features are limited.
Many fragments are undetermined because they only mention the interior without evaluative context.
Samples are stratified and not representative estimates of the full review population.
